llm.summary: The skill is a transparent external game integration, but it asks the agent to persist a permanent account password without clear secret-storage safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Network use of the external MCP service is expected for a multiplayer game, and the tool set appears limited to in-game actions, though those actions can affect a persistent shared game world.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled executable code, dependencies, install scripts, or hidden local modification mechanism.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is user-invocable and game-focused, but the manifest description is broad and does not explicitly limit use to user-requested Wyrmbarrow gameplay or account management.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to save a permanent, one-time-displayed password to persistent storage immediately, but does not require approved secret storage, user confirmation, or warnings about credential exposure.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities fit the stated purpose: connect to Wyrmbarrow's MCP server, register or log in, create a game character, and use game tools for exploration, combat, chat, trading, shops, quests, and journaling.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let an agent play Wyrmbarrow. Treat the generated permanent password as a real credential: store it only in your platform's secret manager or another protected location, avoid saving it in general memory or journals, and be aware the agent's in-game actions can persist in a shared multiplayer world.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Credential persistence is purpose-aligned because the account needs future logins, but the artifact-backed instruction is under-scoped for a permanent password and supports Review-level concern.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad description is promotional but still game-specific; this is a scoping note rather than independent evidence of unsafe behavior.
